title: Egg mod
description: Plays funny custom sounds whenever your eggs or snowballs hit another player. Client-side, works everywhere!
body:
#  Projectile Hit Sounds (Client-Side)

A lightweight, **client-side** Fabric mod that adds funny custom sound effects whenever you hit another player with a snowball or an egg!
##  Features

* **Custom Audio:** Unique and funny sound effects separate for eggs and snowballs.
* **Directional Sound:** The audio plays exactly at the coordinate where the projectile bursts against the player, giving you perfect spatial awareness.
* **Universal Server Support:** Works on **absolutely any server** (Vanilla, local worlds, Hypixel, or any minigame server). The server doesn't need to have this mod installed!
* **In-game Volume Control:** Full integration with **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config API**, providing a custom volume slider right in your mod settings.
